verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Mixpanel serves a proper llms.txt file at docs.mixpanel.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured links to its docs, directly satisfying the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented documentation. This is corroborated by first-party docs describing an MCP server for AI assistants to query Mixpanel data via natural language, reinforcing an agent-friendly documentation ecosystem. Missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation of llms.txt usage or completeness beyond the single probe.
